description: This file defines the NotesDao class, which provides data access operations for notes stored in a SQLite database. It includes methods for querying, inserting, updating, deleting, and synchronizing notes, as well as observing changes via streams.

classes.name: NotesDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for notes, providing methods to perform CRUD operations, watch for changes, and handle synchronization.

methods.name: watchNotes
methods.description: Returns a stream of note lists filtered by a search query, emitting updates on database change events.

methods.name: watchNoteById
methods.description: Returns a stream that emits updates for a specific note identified by its ID.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Fetches a single note by its ID from the database.

methods.name: upsertLocal
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a note in the local database and notifies listeners about the change.

methods.name: markDeleted
methods.description: Marks a note as deleted by setting the 'deleted' flag and updating related fields.

methods.name: setSyncStatus
methods.description: Sets the synchronization status for a list of note IDs.

methods.name: getNotesForPush
methods.description: Retrieves notes that need to be pushed for synchronization, i.e., those not marked as clean.

methods.name: getLastSyncAtMillis
methods.description: Gets the timestamp of the last successful sync.

methods.name: updateLastSyncAtMillis
methods.description: Updates the last sync timestamp in the database.

methods.name: reconcileRemoteNotes
methods.description: Reconciles remote notes with local storage, applying remote changes based on update timestamps.

methods.name: purgeSyncedTombstones
methods.description: Deletes notes that are marked as deleted, clean, and already synchronized.

methods.name: _queryNotes
methods.description: Internal method to query notes with optional search, supporting escaping for LIKE query.

methods.name: _escapeLike
methods.description: Escapes special characters for LIKE clause safety.

methods.name: _mapRow
methods.description: Maps a database row to a Note object.

methods.name: _toRow
methods.description: Converts a Note object into a map suitable for database insertion or update.
